note: Client matrix of SRS Appendix K (FR-15.10). pinnedVersion null means the matrix job has not yet pinned and run the client. Mechanisms marked confirm=true are taken from vendor documentation and are not yet verified against a pinned version. Cloud agent entries carry tunnelProvider, registrationMode and agentBuild for the dated manual record of FR-15.9; null until a run is recorded; until then each cloud entry is not-run with reviewed (the date the entry was last reviewed) and notRunReason. notes is a plain-language summary of how the client is driven and why it is not run, shown on the project site.

lockdown.mechanism: managed-settings.json: allowedMcpServers, managed-only allowlist, permissions.deny Read and Edit on Gateway paths

clients.label: gateway-available
clients.notes: Driven with the SDK control protocol (stream-json with --permission-prompt-tool stdio): Claude Code asks before every call to a tool marked requiresUserInteraction (FR-1.50), and the suite answers that local prompt for mcp__smcp__ tools only, so the Gateway's hold is exercised and smcpctl approves the call. The native build uses BoringSSL, which rejects iPAddress name constraints; CP-53 CAs carry dNSName constraints only, and an older CA must be replaced with smcpctl keys rotate ca.
